glosses: movement (physical motion between points in space)
movement (a trend in various fields or social categories)

examples.text: Hay mucho movimiento en esa calle.
examples.en: There's a lot of traffic on that street.

examples.text: Ese movimiento fue un gran error.
examples.en: That move was a big mistake.

examples.text: La policía sospechaba de sus movimientos.
examples.en: The police were suspicious of his movements.
